description: This file defines the 'RetrieveSubjectsResponse' class, which represents the response to a 'RetrieveSubjects' command in a policy query context within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating instances from parameters or JSON, accessing retrieved subjects, and serializing to JSON. The class is part of the package related to commands for policies and handles JSON parsing, response creation, and resource path management.

classes.name: RetrieveSubjectsResponse
classes.description: An immutable response class for retrieving subjects associated with a policy, capable of JSON serialization/deserialization, and providing accessors for entity ID, label, and subjects.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of RetrieveSubjectsResponse from given parameters, with deprecated overloads accepting string policy IDs.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs a RetrieveSubjectsResponse object from a JSON string or object, parsing necessary fields.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the PolicyId associated with this response.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the Label associated with the policy entry.

methods.name: getSubjects
methods.description: Returns the Subjects object extracted from the JSON data.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Returns a new instance with a different JSON entity.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with updated DittoHeaders.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON Pointer path to the subjects resource.

methods.description: Appends the object’s payload to a JSON object builder with schema considerations.
